item.description:
• See every running sale and upcoming price change across all your apps on the new Prices page
  • Rank all your apps by rating, ratings count, recent reviews, and unanswered replies on the new Ratings & Reviews page
  • Review the old and new price in every storefront before a bulk price change, and export it as CSV
  • Restore old prices after a sale from Price History, including changes made by AI assistants over MCP
  • Clearer purchasing power options in Bulk Pricing

• Manage several App Store Connect accounts, with keys kept in the Keychain
  • See versions, builds, and TestFlight groups and testers at a glance
  • Edit App Store text per language and browse App Info with screenshots
  • Read customer reviews, see Apple's review summary, and draft replies with on-device AI
  • Change prices in bulk across territories, with a preview before anything changes
  • Set fair prices by purchasing power, price levels, the Big Mac index, or income
  • Schedule price changes for a later date
  • Create offer codes and export them
  • Follow daily units and proceeds on the Sales page
  • Let AI assistants work with your apps through the built-in MCP server
